text_block_list.name: One-Piece Dress Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! We bought so much. Thanks for 
tagging along, Bourbon! The sale was 
packed, so you must be wiped out.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Physical and mental stamina are both 
optimal. No anomalies detected due to the 
sale, Objective: Successfully executed.

text_block_list.name: One-Piece Dress Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Ah... Um, sorry, okay? You didn't 
have fun, did you? Bourbon, you didn't 
smile at all...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: One-Piece Dress Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's fine, it's fine! Anyway, thank 
you! Sorry, see ya later.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. She analyzed my facial 
expression and deduced... "She is bored." 
However, that conclusion is incorrect.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Difficulty C: "Securing sale items" 
accomplished. Acquired her smile. 
...Therefore, the answer to that query is 
determined to be "Yes."
choice_data_list:
I'm sure the misunderstanding will clear 
up soon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Based on past experience, I 
predict the probability of encountering 
the same situation in the future exceeds 
80%.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Next occurrence likely at— the costume 
party venue.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—That video was just so super cute! We 
were saying we should all throw a costume 
party just like the video next time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so. I am glad that Rice-san is 
having fun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Just thinking about what kind of 
costume to wear is already fun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, so you see. Both preparing and 
the actual party will definitely be super 
fun... so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-Would you like to come with us too, 
Bourbon-san!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I nodded once, but I determine high 
probability that my presence would ruin 
the mood of the venue.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I should indeed decline.

Saying so, Mihono Bourbon gave a light bow 
and walked toward the school building.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, whatever is the matter with that 
troubled expression on your face~? Could 
it be that something is bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I would be happy to lend an ear if 
you like♪ Two heads are better than one 
when worrying, so I am sure I can be of 
help.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Bourbon-chan said something like 
that? I plan on participating in the 
costume party as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Understood, leave it to me. I shall try 
talking with Bourbon-chan too. After all, 
it is much better if everyone has fun 
together♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... haah...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Bourbon-cha~n.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Good work on your training. I heard about 
the costume party.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, Creek-san is 
participating as well, correct?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, titled "Everyone Have Fun Costume 
Party"♪ Won't you join in and have fun 
with us, Bourbon-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Rice-chan invited you because you are a 
precious friend, Bourbon-chan. And of 
course, that goes for me too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It could never be boring. If you are not 
there, I will be so lonely I might cry~.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Selecting optimal action 
for participation. Consciously maintain 
smiling expression at all times—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you are fine just the way you are. 
Forcing a fake smile is a big no-no, dear.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...However, in that case...
choice_data_list: I think you're fine as you are!

What about a costume that doesn't require 
changing your expression?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Without changing anything particularly... 
just as I am now?

If it is about "everyone having fun 
together," being yourself is best. Going 
as the usual Mihono Bourbon should allow 
her to enjoy it more comfortably.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's right. There is no need to 
overthink it. Everyone just wants to enjoy 
themselves together with the usual 
Bourbon-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ............ As I am now, my usual self.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Acknowledged. Searching for an 
appropriate costume and commencing 
production immediately.

Before I could even offer to help, Mihono 
Bourbon took off running with incredible 
momentum.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That sounds lovely too~. There is no need 
to turn into something completely 
different. Thinking of a costume that 
suits you is fun on its own~.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Does that imply... a "Cyborg"?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that sounds wonderful too. I am sure 
you would make a strong, cool cyborg♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Commencing mission: "Search 
for a suitable costume." I shall 
definitely clear it.

While the goal was simply to have fun... 
Mihono Bourbon clenched her fist tightly 
toward clearing the mission.
